Where is Koh Tan? | Koh Tan (Koh Taen) lies 4–5 km south of Thong Krut on Koh Samui's south-west coast, about 2 km from Koh Madsum (Pig Island). It is the largest of the three southern islands, with Koh Madsum and Koh Rap.
How do I get to Koh Tan from Koh Samui? | The easiest way is a Pig Island tour from Thong Krut pier, which includes a return hotel transfer from most areas of Koh Samui and snorkelling at Koh Tan. You can also charter a longtail at Thong Krut; the crossing takes 15–30 minutes.
~Is the snorkelling good at Koh Tan? | It is the best easy reef snorkelling close to Samui: a shallow reef along Ao Ok beach that suits beginners and children. Expect patchy coral and reef fish rather than big marine life, and come February–April for the clearest water.
Can you stay overnight on Koh Tan? | Yes, but options are limited. A few basic bungalows operate, several have closed and electricity is limited, so contact them directly before you go and arrange a longtail from Thong Krut. Bring cash, as there are no ATMs.
Is there a fee to land on Koh Tan? | No separate fee is charged for a snorkel or beach stop on Koh Tan. Neighbouring Koh Madsum charges about 50 THB per person in cash, and Koh Rap also charges about 50 THB.
Koh Tan or Pig Island: which is better? | Koh Tan has better snorkelling and fewer people; Koh Madsum has the pigs and a busier beach bar. Every one of our Pig Island trips visits both, from 1,450 THB, so you don't have to choose.
